text:
Dr. Yara Lindqvist directed the excavation at Tel Maridun, according to the Maridun Heritage Authority's Final Excavation Summary, released at the Authority's annual symposium in Valderra.

The document records that the dig's final season closed on 14 September 2019. Over the course of the project, the team recovered 1,284 catalogued artifacts across 11 trenches.

Tomas Adeyemi-Roth, site registrar for the Authority, confirmed Dr. Lindqvist's role as director of the dig. The Summary lists her in that capacity throughout its account of the fieldwork.

The Authority presented the Summary as the formal record of the excavation's results. It did not, in the portions released at the symposium, set out a timetable for further study of the recovered material.
